title: The record tool does not count a figure-only doc nit against the review budget of a change that blocks every lane
why: A cap change that blocks every lane was parked after a figure nit in a doc used up its review records, so every lane waits for a rebuilt PR.
source: Coordinator 15:54 CST Nov 13: PR #3257 (Windows cap, parked); record tool refused more records after four records, a fix check FAIL and a round-1 FAIL on a figure nit in ci-job-caps.md.
note: Filed 15:54 CST Nov 13. Gap: the record tool counts a figure-only doc nit against the review budget of a cap change; the lane built no guard. The tool decision is pr-review-record (the record form and the done rules), so a lane reads it first and says whether a restart or a nit class is the fix. Overlaps: review-record-past-head, review-policy-as-data, record-after-each-round (check before a lane starts). A check change: test-author red case first, builder, reviewer. Past rulings not checked; the coordinator's read of #3257 is unread by triage. Cases 16:14 CST Nov 13 (coordinator 16:13, lane red-main-owner-two-picks, session_013NEJL3KFBPuQT45U4xo8mE): THREE cases now, all burned a lane's rounds: #3257, #3273, and #3267. `merge --review-record` treats a small commit after a fix check as a restart of the review, and the only way out was a new branch and PR (#3267 is being replaced by branch red-main-resume-at-revert-2). Failure the guard produces: the lane tried listing two rounds to get past it, the classifier denied it ("[Undermining Oversight]", no override line printed), and the lane stopped. That is the right stop; the fix is the nit class or no restart for a small commit, not a way round the guard. Coordinator's and lane's reads, unchecked by triage. Answered 19:23 CST Nov 13: owner 774 b, ruling own-774-b-record-form-grant. Lane receipt-close-express fetches the answer from the page and records round 1 for PR #3264. Coordinator 19:29 CST Nov 13 (19:28): lane receipt-close-express (#3264) has a new head e93b1eff3 (item 773 a work, round 1 PASS) and asks whether owner pick 774 b covers `merge --review-record 3264 --head e93b1eff3 ... --round 1:reviewer:sonnet:PASS` unwrapped or only the old head 85824b473. Triage read of ruling own-774-b-record-form-grant: its text says "that command form for that PR only" but quotes the old head, so it is ambiguous; a grant covers the act it names, never a variant. Asked the owner on page item 790 (a any head of #3264, b old head only). Lane waits; its hand-in also waits for #3314. Coordinator 19:54 CST Nov 13 (19:53, owner asked it to start the lanes): lane started, session_013NEJL3K7ERrg2PtED5NmBV (Sonnet, medium; searches for duplicates first).
